concept.name: Web 95
concept.axes: Retro nostalgia · tiled textures · pixel art
concept.brief: Mid-90s desktop web: bevelled windows, title bars, tiled backgrounds, pixel icons, a marquee, a guestbook and a hit counter that ticks up live.
